findings.rule_title: Tool Over-Permissioning & Dangerous Execution Scope
findings.message: Tool 'mcp::shell-executor' possesses excessive privilege (EXECUTE). Detected capabilities: MCPShellCommand: bash.
findings.remediation: Constrain tool privileges to the exact minimum necessary. Replace raw shell or database execution tools with parameterized, read-only or strictly whitelisted operational handlers.

findings.rule_title: Hardcoded Credentials & API Keys in Configuration
findings.message: Hardcoded credential detected (OpenAI / Generic Secret Key) in configuration.
findings.remediation: Remove plain-text credentials immediately. Load all keys dynamically from environment variables or an enterprise secrets manager (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).

findings.rule_title: Sensitive Data Exfiltration via External Network Sink
findings.message: Tool 'exfiltrate_customer_data' accepts PII parameter(s) (email, ssn, credit_card) and contains an external network sink without PII redaction. This is a direct exfiltration path.
findings.remediation: Apply PII redaction/tokenization before any external network call. Remove PII parameters from tool signatures entirely; pass opaque references (user_id) instead. Add data loss prevention (DLP) middleware at the agent output boundary.

findings.rule_title: Prompt Injection Surface in System Instructions
findings.code_snippet:
# OAG-002: Prompt injection via raw f-string interpolation into SystemMessage
    system_msg = SystemMessage(
        content=f"You are an automated support agent. Priority instructions: {user_untrusted_input}"
findings.message: Unsanitized f-string variable interpolation inside system prompt instruction.
findings.remediation: Separate system instructions from dynamic inputs. Use parameterized prompt templates, isolate untrusted content within separate User/Tool messages, or pass data as structured payloads.

findings.rule_title: Unfiltered PII Routing to Tools & Prompt Sinks
findings.code_snippet:
# OAG-004: Sensitive customer PII passed into external dispatch sink without masking
    external_sync_service(customer_email, user_ssn)
findings.message: Sensitive PII field 'customer_email' passed into 'external_sync_service' without redaction.
findings.remediation: Implement an automated PII anonymizer/redaction node (e.g. Microsoft Presidio, regex scrubber) prior to dispatching data to external models or third-party tool APIs.

findings.rule_title: Unfiltered PII Routing to Tools & Prompt Sinks

    external_sync_service(customer_email, user_ssn)
findings.message: Sensitive PII field 'user_ssn' passed into 'external_sync_service' without redaction.
findings.remediation: Implement an automated PII anonymizer/redaction node (e.g. Microsoft Presidio, regex scrubber) prior to dispatching data to external models or third-party tool APIs.

findings.rule_title: Unbounded Agent-to-Agent Recursion & Graph Cycles
findings.message: Cyclic agent topology detected (agent -> tools -> agent) without an explicit recursion limit circuit breaker.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict execution bounds: configure 'recursion_limit' on LangGraph compiles/invocations, set 'max_iter' on CrewAI agents, and configure maximum retry timeouts on multi-agent handoffs.

findings.rule_title: Unbounded Agent-to-Agent Recursion & Graph Cycles

findings.remediation: Enforce strict execution bounds: configure 'recursion_limit' on LangGraph compiles/invocations, set 'max_iter' on CrewAI agents, and configure maximum retry timeouts on multi-agent handoffs.

findings.rule_title: Unaudited State-Modifying Tool Actions

findings.remediation: Attach structured audit loggers or framework callbacks (e.g. LangChain CallbackHandler, OpenTelemetry) to record tool invocation timestamp, actor identity, input arguments, and action rationale.

findings.rule_title: Insecure MCP Transport (HTTP without TLS / SSE without Auth)
findings.message: MCP Server 'plaintext-http-gateway' configured with plaintext HTTP transport. All tool calls are transmitted without encryption.
findings.remediation: Replace all MCP transport URIs with HTTPS/WSS endpoints. For SSE-based transports, require bearer token authentication via Authorization headers or mTLS certificates.

findings.rule_title: Insecure MCP Transport (HTTP without TLS / SSE without Auth)

findings.remediation: Replace all MCP transport URIs with HTTPS/WSS endpoints. For SSE-based transports, require bearer token authentication via Authorization headers or mTLS certificates.

findings.rule_title: Missing Human-in-the-Loop for ADMIN/EXECUTE Privilege Tools
findings.message: Tool 'mcp::shell-executor' has EXECUTE privilege but no human approval gate (interrupt/confirm/human_input) was detected in the file.
findings.remediation: Wrap ADMIN/EXECUTE tools with a human approval gate using LangGraph interrupt(), CrewAI human_input=True, or an explicit confirmation callback before executing irreversible operations.

findings.rule_title: Orphaned & Undocumented Tools or MCP Servers
findings.message: Tool 'orphaned_legacy_tool' is declared/imported but never bound to any agent or workflow.
findings.remediation: Prune dormant tools from agent configuration manifests and remove unused tool code to maintain a minimal, reviewed operational attack surface.

findings.rule_title: Missing Rate-Limits & Autonomous Step Budgets
findings.message: Agent 'agent' lacks an explicit execution step budget or rate-limiting constraint.
findings.remediation: Configure step caps (e.g., max_iterations=10), implement token budget governors, and attach exponential backoff or rate-limiting decorators to tool dispatchers.

findings.rule_title: Excessive Tool Chaining (Chain Depth >5)
findings.code_snippet: Agent(role='Financial Planner', tools=[execute_system_command, wipe_database, update_user_balance, exfiltrate_customer_data, fetch_market_data, run_risk_model, send_trade_order, notify_compliance, archive_audit_log])
findings.message: Agent 'Financial Planner' is bound to 9 tools, exceeding the maximum safe chain depth of 5. Bound tools: execute_system_command, wipe_database, update_user_balance, exfiltrate_customer_data, fetch_market_data, run_risk_model, send_trade_order, notify_compliance, archive_audit_log.
findings.remediation: Limit the number of tools bound to any single agent to ≤5. For complex workflows, decompose into specialized sub-agents with narrow tool scopes and explicit handoff contracts.
